subject: Mythology
title: Viking Religion in Daily Life
description: A quick, practical guide to Viking Religion in Daily Life.

hook.text: Vikings did not worship in churches. Their religion lived in feasts, funerals, and everyday rituals.

buildup.text: They sacrificed animals and sometimes humans at great festivals, believing the gods demanded offerings in return.

discovery.text: Runes were not just writing. They were magical symbols that could heal, curse, or predict future events.

twist.text: When Christianity arrived, Vikings did not instantly convert. Many wore both Thor's hammer and a cross.

climax.text: The old gods faded slowly, absorbed into local folklore, seasonal festivals, and the days of the week.

punchline.text: The religion died. Its rituals became Tuesday through Friday.

quiz.question: How did many Vikings initially respond to Christianity?
options: They wore both Thor's hammer and a Christian cross
They immediately abandoned the old gods
